slots.abstract: The festival taking its toll on you? Come in and relax for a while, take off your costume, and you’ll be ready to party once more within no time! There’s limited space, so be mindful of the needs of others. As long as you can do that, we’ll do our best try to make sure the party never ends!
slots.description:
The festival taking its toll on you? Come in and relax for a while, take off your costume, and you’ll be ready to party once more within no time! There’s limited space, so be mindful of the needs of others. As long as you can do that, we’ll do our best try to make sure the party never ends!
Services:
For those of you who are new around here; welcome! Here’s a short summary of what you can expect from us:

BLOWERS and DRYERS
We have two kinds of fans; some to cool you down, and others to dry your party outfits. You’re free to use them, but due to the limited space, we kindly request you only use them as long as you need. And remember, we don’t take kindly to people mixing them up, spraying the sweat from their costumes into the faces of those trying to cool down; any parts of costumes or clothing found on fans intended to cool people will be removed.

DRINKS and SNACKS
To try and keep the party going, and not in the direction of the first aid station, we’ve got some free hydrating drinks and snacks for those who need it. Nobody likes messy festival grounds, so please reuse the cups if you can (or even bring your own - we don’t mind)! Oh, and please try to keep your costumes and the food separated?

REPAIR WORKSHOP
We try to support even the fanciest, most technical of costumes. We’ve got a repair corner, so if anything is broken, hopefully you’ll be able to patch it up there in no time. Don’t be afraid to ask for help, people are often more than happy to help others!

HELPERS
As always, we’ve got a team of people there to help you. We know some of you have trouble getting in and out of your costumes. Who designs these things anyway, why is the zipper always in such hard to reach places?! Anyway… for that, and anything else you might think of: feel free to ask one of the crew, and they’ll try their best to help you!
Rules:
To make sure everyone stays safe, here is a short list of rules to follow. Please don't argue with our staff if they ask you to follow these simple rules.

NO GLASS IS ALLOWED IN THE FURSUIT LOUNGE.
Drinking glasses and bottles are a lot more dangerous than you might think in a room full of overheating, badly coordinated, half dressed people. To keep everyone and their costumes safe from shards, we don’t allow glass in here. Any glass found will be confiscated, empty or not.

NO PAINT OR OUTSIDE FOOD.
As with glass, “But I’ll be careful!” is not a valid excuse when you’re surrounded with tired, vision-impaired, and possibly inebriated people.

DON’T BLOCK THE FANS.
The fans are there for cooling down, not for spraying sweat all over. If you want to blow your sweat into the faces of others, do that elsewhere. Not to mention, we’d rather not have our fans suck your gear in and catch on fire.

Additionally, we have a lot more visitors than we have space for. Please keep your costumes on the drying constructions for 2 hours at most - any longer than that, and we might have to lend you a hand in making room for others.

NO PHOTO OR VIDEO RECORDING.
People come here to relax, not to be wary of anyone photographing or recording them half-clothed. If you want to take pictures, go elsewhere. No exceptions.

NO SHAPE-RETAINING FURSUIT CASES.
We have limited space to work with, and we are always full. To help as many people as we can, we have to make sure that any bags take as little room as possible while empty. To ensure this, we don’t allow bags and cases that take up as much space full as they do while empty. Bags and cases found breaking these rules might be moved to lost and found.
Location:
Same location as last year, for those who remember it. For those who do not: Hall H, sections 3/4! … and if you can’t find it, just follow the signs, or the constant stream of exhausted party-goers tugging at their costumes.

slots.abstract: Meet fellow artists in a calm, social space to draw, chat, and share ideas. Whether you're working on commissions or just sketching for fun, this is the perfect spot to connect, relax, and enjoy the creative spirit of the fandom together.
slots.description:
Let's be creative together!
Do you enjoy spending your evenings with other fellow and like-minded artists, drawing and chatting about techniques, supplies, and other creative topics? Need a moment to breathe after a strenuous day in the Artist Alley or the Dealers’ Den but still crave creative surroundings? Want a space to have a heartfelt, creative conversation with the artist you haven’t seen at their table during the convention day? Then this social event, taking place every day, is the right place for you!

Sit down with other creatives, share ideas, learn new techniques, chat and have a good time while working on your convention commissions or just being interested in drawing and the art in Furry Fandom. Collaborate on your Dealers’ Den homework with other crafty souls! Our Artists’ Lounge is a hub to escape the buzz of stage events and the convention schedule.

Please note, the Lounge is not curated nor permanently staffed: Be fair and pass on your seat if you won’t be returning for a while. Don’t leave your belongings unattended. If you need immediate help, please contact Security or Con Ops. For any organizational input, visit the Art Show or Dealers’ Den Help Desks during their opening times.

slots.abstract: Because everyone deserves to feel safe and confident at a convention.
slots.description:
This panel is for all furries who identify with the FLINTA (Female, Lesbian, Intersex, Non-binary, Trans and Agender) label who feel at risk of harassment in a male-dominated environment to learn some simple self-defense techniques. We'll start with everyday advice for body language to help avoid bad situations before they happen, then slowly escalate to more physical defense techniques such as how to get away if someone tries to grab you. As a woman who has been training in martial arts for well over a decade, I'm happy to share my knowledge with others. Attendee participation is highly encouraged, but not mandatory. This is a safe environment to learn
and connect with others that share your concerns.

slots.abstract: Say Hi to furs in VRChat from all over the world via our two-way interactive streaming installation!
slots.description:
Online attendees can explore a VRChat world by the VirtualFurence Team that seamlessly connects VRChat with the convention space. Created in partnership with the Eurofurence VR department, which presents and operates the convention-side installation, the experience forges a bridge between both, the virtual and physical world.

The portal also has additional options for interacting with participants on the virtual side:

  • Give other furs a phone call through Virtual Reality using our interactive VRChat Phone installation.
    You can both accept and make calls to designated phones on-site and in VR. Just pick up when the phone is ringing or call someone yourself.

  • From time to time, operators will hand out motion-tracked controllers or other devices that can be used to influence the virtual world from the convention space.

For more information, visit https://ef-vr.awoo.digital/

The introduction to and official start of Eurofurence 30! Newcomers and familiar faces, grab a seat! Find out what treats we have prepared this year. Learn rules of the road and convention etiquette. And witness the first spectacular act of many right here, right now!
This year, our mascot Greeny is racing against the clock to reach festival grounds in the nick of time. Will she make it? Or will we have to cancel the con and go home?

slots.abstract:
From ideas to finished projects: A panel about productivity systems, habits and practical tools to help you build better routines and stay consistent.
Whether for furry projects or anything else you want to finish!
slots.description:
Struggling to finish your artwork or want to start building your fursuit, but your motivation ran off again? Productivity systems can help!

They are structured methods that turn goals into action by building habits and routines that help you even when motivation runs low.

In this panel, I'll give you a personal peek into the world of productivity systems and share some of the tools and techniques.

Best of all, these methods can boost your progress in any area of life, whether it's your creative furry projects or professional work. :P

Come hang out, learn a few tricks, and maybe finally finish that project that's been staring at you ^^!

you can find someone to enjoy your next outdoor adventure with together. All experience
levels and activities are welcome.

slots.abstract: A 60-minute, handcrafted live performance featuring hypnotic, Berlin-inspired techno. Join Asgra on a journey through deep, driving rhythms, immersive atmospheres, and hypnotic grooves, creating a captivating dancefloor experience live in the moment.
slots.description:
A 60-minute, handcrafted live performance featuring hypnotic, Berlin-inspired techno. Join Asgra on a journey through deep, driving rhythms, immersive atmospheres, and hypnotic grooves, creating a captivating dancefloor experience live in the moment.

This performance is aimed at musically curious listeners, techno enthusiasts, and anyone with an appreciation for electronic music beyond the mainstream.

With the rise of AI-generated content, handcrafted music and genuine artistic expression have probably become more valuable than ever. A modular live performance is more than playing curated tracks. It is about creative expression, musical exploration, and creating a unique experience in the moment. While visual art has a strong presence within the furry fandom, this live performance aims to showcase another facet of the fandom's creative energy while bringing people together through music.

slots.abstract: Join us for a brief introduction to Eurofurence's Critter Volunteer Program. First-timers and experienced volunteers will learn what is planned, how we work and how you can get involved.
slots.description:
The Eurofurence Critter System is your chance to support Eurofurence from the inside. Become part of a team that helps to make Eurofurence an unforgettable experience for all of us. Regardless of your skills or previous knowledge: We would like to get to know you!

While the core team takes care of the planning and coordination, the critters are essential to the smooth running of the convention. From helping with events, to assisting with logistics, to lending an extra pair of paws wherever needed. Critters and staff work paw in paw at the convention to bring the magic of Eurofurence to life.

In this introductory panel, you'll get an overview of how the Critter System works, the types of jobs available, how the shifts are organized, and what perks and support you can expect. We’ll also cover any updates for this year and answer your questions directly.

Whether you're just curious, want to give back to the con, or are already an experienced Critter looking for a refresher, we are looking forward to welcoming you to our big and fuzzy team!

slots.abstract:
Heat signatures of fursuits are rather interesting, and here we'll
make them visible!
slots.description:
Fursuits have very interesting heat signatures, showing your body heat, padding,
cooling packs and electronics!
The heads especially look very interesting - often, the breath actually goes
through the eyes, and if you have an active fan, it can show in the snout!
You can get two normal and two thermal photos taken here and retrieve them from a
Telegram channel where you can also look at photos of other suiters.
Please use this service only once per fursuit during this convention.
Previous work can be seen at @ef_thermal and @nfc_thermal on Telegram.

This year at the Fantastic Furry Festival, we proudly present our Grand Festival Locker
Service, open to all attendees ? not just guests of the Art Show or Dealers? Den.
slots.description:
This year at the Fantastic Furry Festival, we proudly present our Grand Festival Locker
Service, open to all attendees.

Should you arrive carrying mighty backpacks, oversized bags too grand for
the bustling halls of art and trade, simply entrust them to our Locker Service. Our

The EF30 Signature Dance is the EF anniversary mini-choreo for everyone! Dance it everywhere! Anytime!
Parks! Places! Trains! Queues! There's no limit ...

Wednesday, Thursday and Friday on the Open Stage!

Links!
- Short tutorial to share!
- Long version with step by step instructions

Spread the videos (and make our own!) – learn the moves – start to dance!

#ef30 #ef30dance #fursuitdance
slots.description:
We celebrate 30 issues of Eurofurence!

It's a Festival. It's special. And some people thought: We need a dance that will always remind us of that great anniversary.

So we came up with this easy to learn, short choreography that works with almost every song and also anywhere inside and outside CCH, from the biggest dancefloor to the smallest queue... as long as there's music (hint: Eurodance works best... wait for the chorus to start, pull in your friends, and then repeat until you suffer ;)

Just choose your favourite music, we recommend 110 bpm or less for beginners, up to 145 for the skilled ones ;)

  • Link 1
    This short example video shows the dance in full.
    Share it a lot so we gather many dancers! Tag it #ef30 #ef30dance #fursuitdance (but fursuit not required :)

We'd also love to see many more Furrys to perform the dance and upload it to the their channel of choice.

  • Link 2
    A full tutorial with instructions for each move (and even some music theory ;) can also be found in the example video.
    Take your time to find out how the dance works. You may spot some references to "3 decades of EF". Share your findings if you like ;)

  • Telegram group
    to connect with other dancers and to stay informed about any bigger appearances or flashmobs during the Con.

Thanks a lot to Fezzle & GermanSkrat for inspiration and to JD Puppy for the great tutorials!

(Note: there is also the 'Large Group Dance' by JD_Puppy – which has a full length choreography for ambitious dancers. Don't miss that one aswell :)

slots.abstract: Zeor Karethran will take you to foreign galaxies with unknown worlds, eerie soundscapes and strange beauty. Space Ambient music at its finest, telling a symphonic poem with synthesizers. Get ready for another installment of the Spheric Worlds concert series at Eurofurence. Using soft clouds, sequences and intricate delicacies, Zeor leaves behind conventional dogmas of music and creates his own universe of sound, conveying gigantic stories within a short time.
slots.description:
Zeor Karethran will take you to foreign galaxies with unknown worlds, eerie soundscapes and strange beauty. Space Ambient music at its finest, telling a symphonic poem with synthesizers. Get ready for another installment of the Spheric Worlds concert series at Eurofurence. Using soft clouds, sequences and intricate delicacies, Zeor leaves behind conventional dogmas of music and creates his own universe of sound, conveying gigantic stories within a short time.
Alternating between the highest summits of joy and towards the deepest valley of darkness, his performances entail a wide spectrum of colors and textures. Zeor wraps the audience into a continuous strand of music which can last for an hour or more.
Regularly, a theremin can be heard, as Zeor is one of the few people worldwide who can play this rare instrument which is played without being touched.

slots.abstract: The festival taking its toll on you? Come in and relax for a while, take off your costume, and you’ll be ready to party once more within no time! There’s limited space, so be mindful of the needs of others. As long as you can do that, we’ll do our best try to make sure the party never ends!
slots.description:
The festival taking its toll on you? Come in and relax for a while, take off your costume, and you’ll be ready to party once more within no time! There’s limited space, so be mindful of the needs of others. As long as you can do that, we’ll do our best try to make sure the party never ends!
Services:
For those of you who are new around here; welcome! Here’s a short summary of what you can expect from us:

BLOWERS and DRYERS
We have two kinds of fans; some to cool you down, and others to dry your party outfits. You’re free to use them, but due to the limited space, we kindly request you only use them as long as you need. And remember, we don’t take kindly to people mixing them up, spraying the sweat from their costumes into the faces of those trying to cool down; any parts of costumes or clothing found on fans intended to cool people will be removed.

DRINKS and SNACKS
To try and keep the party going, and not in the direction of the first aid station, we’ve got some free hydrating drinks and snacks for those who need it. Nobody likes messy festival grounds, so please reuse the cups if you can (or even bring your own - we don’t mind)! Oh, and please try to keep your costumes and the food separated?

REPAIR WORKSHOP
We try to support even the fanciest, most technical of costumes. We’ve got a repair corner, so if anything is broken, hopefully you’ll be able to patch it up there in no time. Don’t be afraid to ask for help, people are often more than happy to help others!

HELPERS
As always, we’ve got a team of people there to help you. We know some of you have trouble getting in and out of your costumes. Who designs these things anyway, why is the zipper always in such hard to reach places?! Anyway… for that, and anything else you might think of: feel free to ask one of the crew, and they’ll try their best to help you!
Rules:
To make sure everyone stays safe, here is a short list of rules to follow. Please don't argue with our staff if they ask you to follow these simple rules.

NO GLASS IS ALLOWED IN THE FURSUIT LOUNGE.
Drinking glasses and bottles are a lot more dangerous than you might think in a room full of overheating, badly coordinated, half dressed people. To keep everyone and their costumes safe from shards, we don’t allow glass in here. Any glass found will be confiscated, empty or not.

NO PAINT OR OUTSIDE FOOD.
As with glass, “But I’ll be careful!” is not a valid excuse when you’re surrounded with tired, vision-impaired, and possibly inebriated people.

DON’T BLOCK THE FANS.
The fans are there for cooling down, not for spraying sweat all over. If you want to blow your sweat into the faces of others, do that elsewhere. Not to mention, we’d rather not have our fans suck your gear in and catch on fire.

Additionally, we have a lot more visitors than we have space for. Please keep your costumes on the drying constructions for 2 hours at most - any longer than that, and we might have to lend you a hand in making room for others.

NO PHOTO OR VIDEO RECORDING.
People come here to relax, not to be wary of anyone photographing or recording them half-clothed. If you want to take pictures, go elsewhere. No exceptions.

NO SHAPE-RETAINING FURSUIT CASES.
We have limited space to work with, and we are always full. To help as many people as we can, we have to make sure that any bags take as little room as possible while empty. To ensure this, we don’t allow bags and cases that take up as much space full as they do while empty. Bags and cases found breaking these rules might be moved to lost and found.
Location:

slots.raw_abstract: The festival taking its toll on you? Come in and relax for a while, take off your costume, and you’ll be ready to party once more within no time! slots.raw_description:
The festival taking its toll on you? Come in and relax for a while, take off your costume, and you’ll be ready to party once more within no time! There’s limited space, so be mindful of the needs of others. As long as you can do that, we’ll do our best try to make sure the party never ends!
Services:
For those of you who are new around here; welcome! Here’s a short summary of what you can expect from us:

**BLOWERS and DRYERS**
We have two kinds of fans; some to cool you down, and others to dry your party outfits. You’re free to use them, but due to the limited space, we kindly request you only use them as long as you need. And remember, we don’t take kindly to people mixing them up, spraying the sweat from their costumes into the faces of those trying to cool down; any parts of costumes or clothing found on fans intended to cool people will be removed.

**DRINKS and SNACKS**
To try and keep the party going, and not in the direction of the first aid station, we’ve got some free hydrating drinks and snacks for those who need it. Nobody likes messy festival grounds, so please reuse the cups if you can (or even bring your own - we don’t mind)! Oh, and please try to keep your costumes and the food separated?

**REPAIR WORKSHOP**
We try to support even the fanciest, most technical of costumes. We’ve got a repair corner, so if anything is broken, hopefully you’ll be able to patch it up there in no time. Don’t be afraid to ask for help, people are often more than happy to help others!

**HELPERS**
As always, we’ve got a team of people there to help you. We know some of you have trouble getting in and out of your costumes. Who designs these things anyway, why is the zipper always in such hard to reach places?! Anyway… for that, and anything else you might think of: feel free to ask one of the crew, and they’ll try their best to help you!
Rules:
To make sure everyone stays safe, here is a short list of rules to follow. Please don't argue with our staff if they ask you to follow these simple rules.

**NO GLASS IS ALLOWED IN THE FURSUIT LOUNGE.**
Drinking glasses and bottles are a lot more dangerous than you might think in a room full of overheating, badly coordinated, half dressed people. To keep everyone and their costumes safe from shards, we don’t allow glass in here. Any glass found will be confiscated, empty or not.

**NO PAINT OR OUTSIDE FOOD.**
As with glass, “But I’ll be careful!” is not a valid excuse when you’re surrounded with tired, vision-impaired, and possibly inebriated people.

**DON’T BLOCK THE FANS.**
The fans are there for cooling down, not for spraying sweat all over. If you want to blow your sweat into the faces of others, do that elsewhere. Not to mention, we’d rather not have our fans suck your gear in and catch on fire.

Additionally, we have a lot more visitors than we have space for. Please keep your costumes on the drying constructions for 2 hours at most - any longer than that, and we might have to lend you a hand in making room for others.

**NO PHOTO OR VIDEO RECORDING.**
People come here to relax, not to be wary of anyone photographing or recording them half-clothed. If you want to take pictures, go elsewhere. No exceptions.

**NO SHAPE-RETAINING FURSUIT CASES.**
We have limited space to work with, and we are always full. To help as many people as we can, we have to make sure that any bags take as little room as possible while empty. To ensure this, we don’t allow bags and cases that take up as much space full as they do while empty. Bags and cases found breaking these rules might be moved to lost and found.
Location:
Same location as last year, for those who remember it. For those who do not: Hall H, sections 3/4! … and if you can’t find it, just follow the signs, or the constant stream of exhausted party-goers tugging at their costumes.

Do you enjoy spending your evenings with other fellow and like-minded artists, drawing and chatting about techniques, supplies, and other creative topics? Need a moment to breathe after a strenuous day in the Artist Alley or the Dealers’ Den but still crave creative surroundings? Want a space to have a heartfelt, creative conversation with the artist you haven’t seen at their table during the convention day? Then this social event, taking place every day, is the right place for you!

Sit down with other creatives, share ideas, learn new techniques, chat and have a good time while working on your convention commissions or just being interested in drawing and the art in Furry Fandom. Collaborate on your Dealers’ Den homework with other crafty souls! Our Artists’ Lounge is a hub to escape the buzz of stage events and the convention schedule.

Please note, the Lounge is not curated nor permanently staffed: Be fair and pass on your seat if you won’t be returning for a while. Don’t leave your belongings unattended. If you need immediate help, please contact Security or Con Ops. For any organizational input, visit the Art Show or Dealers’ Den Help Desks during their opening times.

slots.abstract:
A practical longevity panel covering sleep, nutrition, movement, supplements,
environmental risks, mental health, and convention recovery. After last year’s successful
discussion, this updated EF30 edition adds a stronger focus on mental wellbeing in the
furry community.
slots.description:
Health and longevity are not only about living longer. They are about having more energy,
recovering better, thinking clearly, and actually enjoying life, including conventions.

This panel gives a practical introduction to the foundations of health: sleep, nutrition,
movement, recovery, supplements, environmental exposures, and realistic habits that work
outside of perfect routines. It will also look at convention-specific challenges such as
sleep debt, irregular meals, over-stimulation, alcohol, social intensity, and post-con
exhaustion.

A major focus this year will be mental health in the furry community: loneliness,
belonging, social anxiety, emotional safety, burnout, identity, and the post-con depression
many people experience after an intense event.

The panel will combine a structured overview, practical takeaways, myth-busting, audience
discussion, and Q&A. It will also point interested participants toward relevant longevity,
health, and mental well being communities where they can continue learning, connecting, and
building healthier routines after EF30.

slots.abstract:
Have you ever wanted to get more involved with the local furry crowd?
Want to start a local furry meet, but don't know where to begin?
Or are you looking for fresh ideas to improve your own meets and events?

Then this panel is exactly right for you!
We'll show you practical ways to kickstart new events, improve existing ones and help your local furry community thrive, with learnings from our own meet.
slots.description:
In this panel you'll learn the fundamentals of organizing local furry events and building a welcoming community.

We will cover practical tips, common pitfalls to avoid and proven approaches to creating successful, sustainable events. You'll get to know, how to handle challenges that organizers commonly encounter and how to create an environment where newcomers and regular attendees feel welcome.

The panel will have an open discussion where everyone is encouraged to share experiences, ideas, and learnings about community building and event management.

slots.abstract: Part of being a furry is about the characters we create- what makes them unique to us and the stories we build around them. Using the speed-dating format, attendees take turns chatting with lots of different people, sharing insight on their creative process and the opportunity to make new friends.
slots.description:
This panel is all about meeting new people with a shared love of character creation and
lore. Meant for everyone from newbies creating their first character to hardcore writers, the speed-dating style set up gets attendees talking. This can include all original characters, from fursonas to Dungeons and Dragons player characters. After an initial ice-breaker of collaborative character creation, attendees are randomly paired up and the main event begins. A selection of questions will be provided but people are encouraged to go off script to get to know each other and share their creativity.
Attendees get 5 minutes to chat, before moving onto the next person, and continues on until the end.
This is a SFW event.

If you decide to take a break or have enough work to keep you busy, give another artist the opportunity by handing over an empty table.

or single digits? Have you always been a little sad that there was never a meet & greet
that quite fit you, like what the cats, dogs, and foxes get? Or hell, have you been
considering making a new, unique looking sona, and want to look for inspiration from other
people with novel designs?

If any of the above fits you, or if you want to visit for any other reason, feel free to
come by the Rare Animals Meet & Greet! We?ll have a space for sharing stickers of your
cool designs, and accommodation like fans and water for fursuiters as well. Around the
start of the meet, we?ll have a group photo, showing off all the rare and unique animals
gathered from across the universe in one place!

slots.abstract:
Ever thought "other people photos are always better"? Want to learn different ways
to approach furry photography? Are you a fursuiter and want to learn how to pose
better? In this presentation I will share my experiences that lead me where I am
now, that maybe can help you too: composition, poses, editing styles, pushing
yourself to reach that goal!
slots.description:
Ever thought "other people photos are always better"? Want to learn different ways
to approach furry photography? Are you a fursuiter and want to learn how to pose
better? In this presentation I will share my experiences that lead me where I am
now, that maybe can help you too: composition, poses, editing styles, pushing
yourself to reach that goal!

This presentation is suitable for new and non-experienced furry photographers,

slots.abstract: Say Hi to furs in VRChat from all over the world via our two-way interactive streaming installation!
slots.description:
Online attendees can explore a VRChat world by the VirtualFurence Team that seamlessly connects VRChat with the convention space. Created in partnership with the Eurofurence VR department, which presents and operates the convention-side installation, the experience forges a bridge between both, the virtual and physical world.

The portal also has additional options for interacting with participants on the virtual side:

  • Give other furs a phone call through Virtual Reality using our interactive VRChat Phone installation.
    You can both accept and make calls to designated phones on-site and in VR. Just pick up when the phone is ringing or call someone yourself.

  • From time to time, operators will hand out motion-tracked controllers or other devices that can be used to influence the virtual world from the convention space.

For more information, visit https://ef-vr.awoo.digital/

slots.abstract:
Meetup for enjoyers of Metal, Goth, Industrial, dark
Electro and all things in between. We welcome all who are connecting with the music, vibe,
aesthetic and people. We want to provide a hangout spot with some music in the background
to find new friends and share experiences.
slots.description:
We plan to have a slightly moderated meetup so people from the Metal, Goth,
Industrial, dark Electro and surrounding scenes can find each other. Fitting to this years
theme of Eurofurence, we want to encourage people to speak about concerts and festivals.
Also to help to discover other topic relevant Furdances and communities and advertise
their offering. That way we can provide a space to further grow this niche in the fandom
and to make people aware about how many Furries are into this lifestyle. We would like to
have some background music and maybe a microphone, to have an easier moderation
possibility and with the music, provide a more relaxed space to hang out and chill with
like minded Furries.

slots.abstract: The Furauction is a special charity event where attendees can bid on a one-on-one interaction with a fursuiter.
slots.description:
The Furauction is a special charity event where attendees can bid on a one-on-one interaction with a fursuiter. This interaction, which typically lasts for an hour, can involve various SFW activities, such as casual conversations, hugs, photoshoots, or meetups. The exact nature of the interaction is mutually agreed upon, ensuring the comfort and consent of both parties.

Fursuiters may establish specific boundaries ahead of time, which they can adjust as necessary to maintain their personal comfort levels. Importantly, all interactions must adhere to Eurofurence’s legal and ethical standards, meaning that no inappropriate requests are allowed, and all activities are conducted in a professional manner.

A spotter or handler can be present during the interaction to ensure the safety and comfort of the fursuiter. Their role is to monitor the engagement and intervene if needed, ensuring that the experience remains safe and respectful for both the bidder and the fursuiter.

The fursuiter is also empowered to leave the interaction early if they feel uncomfortable or unwell, ensuring their well-being remains a priority. Similarly, no requests can involve the removal of the fursuit, except for health concerns.

General rules include no inappropriate touching, maintaining the SFW nature of the interaction, and upholding professional conduct throughout. Both the fursuiter and the bidder are expected to follow these rules to create a positive, safe, and enjoyable experience for all involved.

slots.abstract:
An inside look at the process of designing an original furry-themed board game,
from early concepts to a playable prototype, including creative challenges and
lessons learned as an indie developer.
slots.description:
This panel would present the development journey of Nexus Arena, an original
competitive board game featuring anthropomorphic characters in 1 vs 1 scenarios in
card battles. The talk focuses on the creative and technical process behind
building a tabletop game from scratch: early design ideas, prototyping challenges,
art direction decisions, mechanical iteration, and practical lessons learned
during development, as well as the problemsolving pipline that I faced.

slots.abstract:
Burnout is a nightmare that haunts many of us,
especially today, in times of expectations getting bigger and bigger. But what is it? How
to deal with it? Let's talk about this problem in a safe space!
slots.description:
Our community is full of hard working creatures who in one way or another
experienced burnout, no matter what the job is. As one of them, I'd like to share some
personal thoughts about it and invite you to discuss it in a safe space.

The panel will start with a short presentation on the topic, how burnout can affect us and
how to notice its symptoms. The second, bigger part will be a moderated, roundtable-like
discussion: everyone can participate, everyone can share their thoughts, everyone's equal.
And most importantly: during that discussion we don't judge each other, we don't call out
each other. The main purpose is to try to fight back this monster that haunts us.

Due to the sensitive subject, I'd like you not to take any photos, do not record the
meeting and keep to yourself what will be said here.

slots.abstract:
Japan has anime. The US has superheroes. What can Europe offer today?
European animation once filled the world with unforgettable characters, from Maya the Bee, the Smurfs and Moomins to Asterix and Tintin. Yet while our animation industry still exists, new characters from Europe with lasting cultural impact have become increasingly rare. Why is that?

Join us on a journey through Europe's long relationship with animal characters, from ancient mythology to fables, heraldry, and modern-day cartoons. We’ll also encounter an emerging creative experiment that explores what happens when our history is treated not simply as folklore, but as a source for designing fun and vibrant characters and worlds.

A one-hour mental playground of stories, discoveries, and ideas to keep your mind moving.
slots.description:
When was the last time you spent quality time with the characters you grew up with? Want to learn fun facts about the characters your ancestors knew thousands of years ago?

We’ll travel from the ’80s and ’90s to ancient Europe and back again, jumping between animation, mythology, heraldry, national symbols, and the creatures that have helped European storytellers imagine captivating stories. We’ll have a look at an ongoing creative experiment called The Zeuniks, and uncover some of the discoveries, design decisions, wrong turns, and hidden connections behind its characters.

For visual artists: there are ideas to explore, mistakes to learn from, and new references to add to your visual vocabulary. For everyone else, this is your chance to kick back and stimulate your mind without reaching out to your phones. Discover characters you may have forgotten - or never knew you carried with you.

About the presenter
David Hoffmann studied Computer Animation in Orlando, Florida, and currently works as an Art Director and Illustrator in Berlin.

Have you done your 'research'? It's time to put it to the test - on stage, in front of a
room full of people! Welcome to the e621 Gameshow, guaranteed to be embarrassing whether

What on earth does 'tug_of_vore' mean? Why are there so many images of SCP-1471-a? And who
is REALLY more popular - Garfield or Bubsy? It turns out that, despite popular belief,
there really ARE bad questions - but I've never let that stop me, so come and answer them
in The e621 Gameshow! I've got a bunch of questions about that favourite blue website of
ours - so either cheer from the audience, or if you're brave, come up on stage and show
just how much you know! Together, we'll find out - who's Eurofurence's horniest
attendee...?

Warning: The hosts are not associated with e621 except in the obvious ways. They are also
not responsible for any mental scarring resulting from this panel or their favourites
lists. Also, we won't explicitly be showing porn, but c'mon, it's about e621, so. Yeah.
Prepare yourself accordingly.

slots.abstract:
Heat signatures of fursuits are rather interesting, and here we'll
make them visible!
slots.description:
Fursuits have very interesting heat signatures, showing your body heat, padding,
cooling packs and electronics!
The heads especially look very interesting - often, the breath actually goes
through the eyes, and if you have an active fan, it can show in the snout!
You can get two normal and two thermal photos taken here and retrieve them from a
Telegram channel where you can also look at photos of other suiters.
Please use this service only once per fursuit during this convention.
Previous work can be seen at @ef_thermal and @nfc_thermal on Telegram.

slots.abstract:
Easy to learn, works with any song, and made just for EFs 30th anniversary:

The EF30 Signature Dance is the EF anniversary mini-choreo for everyone! Dance it everywhere! Anytime!
Parks! Places! Trains! Queues! There's no limit ...

Wednesday, Thursday and Friday on the Open Stage!

Links!
- Short tutorial to share!
- Long version with step by step instructions
- Unofficial Telegram group

Spread the videos (and make our own!) – learn the moves – start to dance!

#ef30 #ef30dance #fursuitdance
slots.description:
We celebrate 30 issues of Eurofurence!

It's a Festival. It's special. And some people thought: We need a dance that will always remind us of that great anniversary.

So we came up with this easy to learn, short choreography that works with almost every song and also anywhere inside and outside CCH, from the biggest dancefloor to the smallest queue... as long as there's music (hint: Eurodance works best... wait for the chorus to start, pull in your friends, and then repeat until you suffer ;)

Just choose your favourite music, we recommend 110 bpm or less for beginners, up to 145 for the skilled ones ;)

  • Link 1
    This short example video shows the dance in full.
    Share it a lot so we gather many dancers! Tag it #ef30 #ef30dance #fursuitdance (but fursuit not required :)

We'd also love to see many more Furrys to perform the dance and upload it to the their channel of choice.

  • Link 2
    A full tutorial with instructions for each move (and even some music theory ;) can also be found in the example video.
    Take your time to find out how the dance works. You may spot some references to "3 decades of EF". Share your findings if you like ;)

  • Telegram group
    to connect with other dancers and to stay informed about any bigger appearances or flashmobs during the Con.

Thanks a lot to Fezzle & GermanSkrat for inspiration and to JD Puppy for the great tutorials!

(Note: there is also the 'Large Group Dance' by JD_Puppy – which has a full length choreography for ambitious dancers. Don't miss that one aswell :)

substantial, warm-sounding PA system and an audience with an appreciation for
sophisticated electronic sounds.

slots.abstract:
A meetup for hypno fans!

Be a hypnotist, a trancy subject, or just very curious about the fantasy side of hypno... simply join in and get connected with like minded furrys (and maybe enjoy some trance).

The field of hypno ranges from guided dreams to kinky ideas, while the panel is SFW you're free to find someone answering aaaaalll your questions if you have them!
slots.description:
Fans of hypnosis and mindplay spread across all tribes, all ages, all contexts, and many many Telegram groups ;-)

Here's the chance to meet them, or to meet them again. Enjoy a talkative, unmoderated networking meetup to meet your friends or make new ones. If you're a newbie and curious about the topic, join us and ask and listen a lot ;)

Use for hypno play in the fandom ranges from pure relaxation and de-stressing to fursona transformation, dream journey settings, and (of course) kinky topics. Well, we will keep it a SFW event here, but asking about "what's possible" or contributing your own ideas or experience is highly appreciated!

Artwork Credits: PuaroTheRaccoon/RubyCloud

slots.description: Light can make or break an image. It shapes mood, depth, and atmosphere, and often determines whether a piece feels stunning or just slightly off. Award-winning artist Alector Fencer - and friends - will guide you through a lecture on how light affects a scene, how it interacts with different surfaces, and how to draw it effectively. As always, expect plenty of hands-on examples, including fur, various types of armor, and - for the naughty ones - latex.

have a fun program in store for you. Participation involves accepting [REDACTED].

slots.abstract: Ever thought what your character would look like in a film? Join 2 cinema-aligned creators, Hyroe and Xodiz to learn how to bring your sona to life through VRChat and Blender.
slots.description:
This panel explores how anyone can bring their characters to a cinematic
medium through easily available 3D models and VRChat (Hyroe) and Blender (Xodiz).

After establishing film fundamentals, we will split the panel into 2 halves on our respective mediums.

Hyroe will show you how to bring your character into 3D, and then his workflow and breakdown on the creation of his short-film "Love you Brother" while explaining the technicalities of creating a film solo in VRChat, which isn't just for VR users - desktop users can do it too!

Xodiz will give a basis of Blender: Quick rigging, posing, and animation, along with the necessary pre and post-production skills needed to take an idea from writing to finished product. He will show his personal workflow of a complete render, bringing to light the surprisingly easy methods behind creating high quality, cinematic renders.

slots.abstract:
Epoxy resin allows you to create art in literally any form possible. Casting a glow-in-the-dark snout for your suit? Creating some furry-styled window pane? Or crafting your very own screen for a lamp?

This panel is your chance to get a first glimpse into the world of resin casting - what you need to start, how to handle the stuff safely and some of the pitfalls to avoid.

No prior knowledge required.
slots.description:
We will start out with how to handle resin in a safe way and what to expect when coloring it. We will continue by exploring how to cast resin and how to get rid of those pesky air bubbles. Finally we will casually stroll into the territory of finishing the surface: How to sand and polish the surface.

Basically a broad overview from nothing to the first piece of art.

The panel covers
- What is resin and how can you make it work for your project
- How to (long term) survive your new hobby
- What challenges will you meet when creating resin stuff and how to avoid them
- How to post-process the cast

slots.abstract: Step into Aurora Cuddles part 2, a cozy sanctuary designed for pure decompression. Trade the festive noise for a sea of fluffy pillows, soft-glow lights, and gentle music. It's a warm, grounded den where the only goal is to sink in the fluff, share a snuggle, whisper a story and recharge your spirit.
slots.description:
Step away from the festival rush and into a pop-up sanctuary designed for the art of doing absolutely nothing. This is a grounded, tactile haven where
the "aurora" isn't in the sky - it's the soft, hazy comfort of a room designed for a total sensory reset.

The Sanctuary
Forget the harsh glare of strobe lights and the roar of festival playlists. Here, the world is soft. The space is bathed in a low, amber glow. It?s a warm, earthy den where every surface is soft to the touch.

Recharge Your Spirit
This is your invitation to trade the festive "noise" for a sea of stillness.
Aurora Cuddles part 2 isn't about the party; it's about the recovery. It's the warm, grounded hug you need to feel like yourself again.
"Leave the chaos outside. Sink in, breathe deep, and just be."

Please be sure to cover all areas that could transfer sweat or other chemicals to fursuits.

slots.abstract:
You are a Softsuiter or just interested in the concept of softsuiting? Lets meet up! At
this event you can wear your softsuit openly, with the sheath out, with the plushdick or
plush vulva. Take photos, enjoy the atmosphere and be free and dance!
(No real genitals allowed!)
slots.description:
The concept of softsuiting is nothing new, but finally gets some more attention as the world and the fandom gets more and more kink friendly and open-minded. Softsuiting as a term means nothing more, than fursuiting with fake genitals visible. It is not per-se murrsuiting, as no real genitals are visible. Still considered a soft-kink, there are more and more artists who build these special accessoires for fursuiters, so you can enjoy the full natural look of your fursona in real life.

At this event we would like to provide a place, where we can meet up, invite fursuit builders who are interested or just hang out with other softsuiters who usually hide behind closed doors. If you are just interested in seeing softsuits, join in! We will have photographers on side, to take suggestive photos
of softsuiters who show up, too. If people want to show up with bits etc. please hide everything until you are inside the club! And of course all people who are not fursuiters or softsuiters, are welcome too!

Plus: We are going to have a little dance as well! Let your bits bounce around and be free! 🥰

Telegram Channel

slots.abstract: The festival taking its toll on you? Come in and relax for a while, take off your costume, and you’ll be ready to party once more within no time! There’s limited space, so be mindful of the needs of others. As long as you can do that, we’ll do our best try to make sure the party never ends!
slots.description:
The festival taking its toll on you? Come in and relax for a while, take off your costume, and you’ll be ready to party once more within no time! There’s limited space, so be mindful of the needs of others. As long as you can do that, we’ll do our best try to make sure the party never ends!
Services:
For those of you who are new around here; welcome! Here’s a short summary of what you can expect from us:

BLOWERS and DRYERS
We have two kinds of fans; some to cool you down, and others to dry your party outfits. You’re free to use them, but due to the limited space, we kindly request you only use them as long as you need. And remember, we don’t take kindly to people mixing them up, spraying the sweat from their costumes into the faces of those trying to cool down; any parts of costumes or clothing found on fans intended to cool people will be removed.

DRINKS and SNACKS
To try and keep the party going, and not in the direction of the first aid station, we’ve got some free hydrating drinks and snacks for those who need it. Nobody likes messy festival grounds, so please reuse the cups if you can (or even bring your own - we don’t mind)! Oh, and please try to keep your costumes and the food separated?

REPAIR WORKSHOP
We try to support even the fanciest, most technical of costumes. We’ve got a repair corner, so if anything is broken, hopefully you’ll be able to patch it up there in no time. Don’t be afraid to ask for help, people are often more than happy to help others!

HELPERS
As always, we’ve got a team of people there to help you. We know some of you have trouble getting in and out of your costumes. Who designs these things anyway, why is the zipper always in such hard to reach places?! Anyway… for that, and anything else you might think of: feel free to ask one of the crew, and they’ll try their best to help you!
Rules:
To make sure everyone stays safe, here is a short list of rules to follow. Please don't argue with our staff if they ask you to follow these simple rules.

NO GLASS IS ALLOWED IN THE FURSUIT LOUNGE.
Drinking glasses and bottles are a lot more dangerous than you might think in a room full of overheating, badly coordinated, half dressed people. To keep everyone and their costumes safe from shards, we don’t allow glass in here. Any glass found will be confiscated, empty or not.

NO PAINT OR OUTSIDE FOOD.
As with glass, “But I’ll be careful!” is not a valid excuse when you’re surrounded with tired, vision-impaired, and possibly inebriated people.

DON’T BLOCK THE FANS.
The fans are there for cooling down, not for spraying sweat all over. If you want to blow your sweat into the faces of others, do that elsewhere. Not to mention, we’d rather not have our fans suck your gear in and catch on fire.

Additionally, we have a lot more visitors than we have space for. Please keep your costumes on the drying constructions for 2 hours at most - any longer than that, and we might have to lend you a hand in making room for others.

NO PHOTO OR VIDEO RECORDING.
People come here to relax, not to be wary of anyone photographing or recording them half-clothed. If you want to take pictures, go elsewhere. No exceptions.

NO SHAPE-RETAINING FURSUIT CASES.
We have limited space to work with, and we are always full. To help as many people as we can, we have to make sure that any bags take as little room as possible while empty. To ensure this, we don’t allow bags and cases that take up as much space full as they do while empty. Bags and cases found breaking these rules might be moved to lost and found.
Location:
Same location as last year, for those who remember it. For those who do not: Hall H, sections 3/4! … and if you can’t find it, just follow the signs, or the constant stream of exhausted party-goers tugging at their costumes.

slots.abstract: Meet talented creators offering sketches, badges, prints and more in a casual, ever-changing space. Artists can join on a first-come, first-served basis, making each visit a unique experience. Stop by, browse the art and enjoy a chat with the artists.
slots.description:
The Artist Alley is a vibrant space, located in Foyer Z, where artists can showcase and sell prints, badges, sketches, commissions, books, comics, T-shirts and even more. Whether you're a fan looking to discover unique art or a creative mind wanting to share your creations, the Artist Alley is the perfect place to connect and engage.

With the Eurofurence smartphone app, you can now stay up-to-date with a flexible seating plan, letting you know who is selling at the Artist Alley right now. Take some time to explore the offerings, have a proper look at the goods, and enjoy a pleasant chat with the artists.

Haven’t applied for the Dealers’ Den but love to draw or craft?
Then the Artist Alley might be just the place for you! There is no application necessary. Just grab an empty table on a "first come, first served" basis and follow the sign-up instructions located at each seat. Feel free to offer your services with sketches, badges, prints, and a smile. If you decide to take a break or have enough work to keep you busy, give another artist the opportunity by handing over an empty table.

slots.abstract: Meet fellow artists in a calm, social space to draw, chat, and share ideas. Whether you're working on commissions or just sketching for fun, this is the perfect spot to connect, relax, and enjoy the creative spirit of the fandom together.
slots.description:
Let's be creative together!
Do you enjoy spending your evenings with other fellow and like-minded artists, drawing and chatting about techniques, supplies, and other creative topics? Need a moment to breathe after a strenuous day in the Artist Alley or the Dealers’ Den but still crave creative surroundings? Want a space to have a heartfelt, creative conversation with the artist you haven’t seen at their table during the convention day? Then this social event, taking place every day, is the right place for you!

Sit down with other creatives, share ideas, learn new techniques, chat and have a good time while working on your convention commissions or just being interested in drawing and the art in Furry Fandom. Collaborate on your Dealers’ Den homework with other crafty souls! Our Artists’ Lounge is a hub to escape the buzz of stage events and the convention schedule.

Please note, the Lounge is not curated nor permanently staffed: Be fair and pass on your seat if you won’t be returning for a while. Don’t leave your belongings unattended. If you need immediate help, please contact Security or Con Ops. For any organizational input, visit the Art Show or Dealers’ Den Help Desks during their opening times.

slots.abstract:
In the past days we have filled the nights with music, lights, and created unforgettable memories. From foxes to rabbits, dogs to squirrels, mythical beasts to digital creatures, every species has a place at Eurofurence. It is this incredible diversity of characters, creativity, and people that makes the furry fandom unlike any other.
We invite you to join us for the Parade of a Thousand Species as we bring the spirit of Eurofurence into the neighborhood surrounding the CCH.
slots.description:
See And Be Seen

Along the way, we'll meet humans big and small, admire the beautiful surrounding park, and celebrate the furry fandom together. To help make the experience enjoyable for everyone, we've prepared a few simple etiquette guidelines. Following them will help ensure the parade runs smoothly for participants, spectators, photographers, and our hosts alike.

  • Celebrate the furry fandom in its best light. Bring your favorite fursuit and help create a welcoming, joyful atmosphere for everyone. To keep the parade focused on celebrating our community, we kindly ask you to leave political statements, territorial flags, military uniforms, weapons, and similar imagery at home.
  • Everyone is welcome to join the celebration If you're bringing friends or family, or if you're visiting from another fandom, we'd love to have you along. We simply ask that the front section of the parade remains reserved for participants wearing fursuits.
  • Please respect our venue and our hosts. Stay on the designated route, and help us protect the surrounding flower beds, lawns, and other planted areas by not stepping into them. The photographers will thank you, and so will the gardeners.

The Route

Our team was tasked to find routes accessible to all furry species, no matter if they move on two or four paws, wings or wheels. They marked your path and set up safety points to provide you with fresh water or guide you to a shortcut.

  • The full route is about 1.7 km in length. There is a short section of solid lawn, as well as a section with a 3m incline over 50m. Fursuiters on unpowered wheels might have to ask for thrust assistance in these areas.
  • Shortcut A bypasses the lawn and lake area, and reduces parade length to about 1.5 km.
  • Shortcut B. Should you still find yourself unable to follow the festival’s parade main route, this shortcut is for you. At 1.1 km length, it skips the park exploration and leads directly to a recreational area of some tiny creatures, a so called:
  • Playground. Here you can catch up with the rest of your team and join them for the way back to our base. We kindly ask everyone to keep in mind that the little creatures are not being offered as a convenient take-away snack from the food trucks; photos with them may be taken if explicitly requested.

This year at the Fantastic Furry Festival, we proudly present our Grand Festival Locker
Service, open to all attendees ? not just guests of the Art Show or Dealers? Den.

Should you arrive carrying mighty backpacks, oversized bags, or travel gear too grand for
the bustling halls of art and trade, simply entrust them to our Locker Service. Our
dedicated crew of festival guardians will carefully watch over your belongings while you
set off to explore the colorful avenues of creativity. Before handing over your items,
please make sure to follow the Rules for Accepted Luggage Items, so our team can assist
you safely and swiftly.

And heed this final festival tale: keep an eye on our closing times, lest your belongings
be carried off into long-term storage for an additional fee ? where, as some whisper,
unattended bags may one day become part of the festival?s ever-growing legends!

slots.abstract:
Aidshilfe Hamburg is returning to Eurofurence! Drop by
their booth for friendly tips and information on safer sex, STIs, and how to look after
and protect both yourself and your partners.
In an additional effort to support community health, they will be offering
HIV-quick-tests.
slots.description:
The topic is omnipresent in our society, and even in the ever-growing furry
fandom. It happens that people are affected, whether directly or indirectly. We're talking
about sexually transmittable infections (STI for short) and it's not only about HIV and
AIDS, it's about much more. Because it's important to be well informed about this topic,
we invited the Aidshilfe Hamburg e.V. to do their information work at Eurofurence. For
that they will be there with an information booth. So, don't hesitate to speak with them.
This year they also offer HIV-Quicktests, you will get more Information at their booth.

hosted event.

slots.abstract: Say Hi to furs in VRChat from all over the world via our two-way interactive streaming installation!
slots.description:
Online attendees can explore a VRChat world by the VirtualFurence Team that seamlessly connects VRChat with the convention space. Created in partnership with the Eurofurence VR department, which presents and operates the convention-side installation, the experience forges a bridge between both, the virtual and physical world.

The portal also has additional options for interacting with participants on the virtual side:

  • Give other furs a phone call through Virtual Reality using our interactive VRChat Phone installation.
    You can both accept and make calls to designated phones on-site and in VR. Just pick up when the phone is ringing or call someone yourself.

  • From time to time, operators will hand out motion-tracked controllers or other devices that can be used to influence the virtual world from the convention space.

For more information, visit https://ef-vr.awoo.digital/

slots.abstract:
When crafting art with liquid material like epoxy resin, silicone or 2k-foam, one usually needs a casting form. While standard molds are available at places like eBay or Amazon, it is much more satisfying to create an individual mold with Blender.
In a hands-on session, we will look at how to get started using Blender, with no prior knowledge required.
slots.description:
In this panel we will take a look into modelling in 3D - with a beginner's eye and with the focus on 3D prints, which can be used to create silicone molds to pour epoxy resin.

You will be shown a beginner-friendly tool-chain without any special hardware or license fee required, so you can jump-start your modelling career.

Topics covered
* how to vectorize your hand-drawn art using Inkscape
* how to combine curves and meshes in Blender to model a mold
* typical mistakes and how to avoid them
* how to use geometry nodes to get rid of pesky housekeeping in your model
* a very short introduction into sculpting

This session is meant as a primer for you to find out whether this hobby might be suitable for you and also as a starting point to dive deeper.

slots.abstract: Explore artwork, fursuits, handmade goods, and convention-exclusive treasures from talented creators. Don’t miss the Convention Store for official Eurofurence merch and rare collectibles — the perfect way to take a piece of the convention home with you.
slots.description:
Step into the glow of the Dealers' Den in Hall H, Sections 6 to 8, where artists and creators from across the fandom come together to share their work. You'll find a wide range of treasures to explore — from prints, badges, sketches, commissions, books, comics, and T-shirts to handmade accessories, fursuits, and sweet treats.

Whether you're looking for something specific or just browsing, take your time and enjoy the variety. Many dealers created themed goods and Eurofurence exclusives that you won't find anywhere else. It's a great opportunity to take a piece of the convention home with you.

Looking for something to remember EF 30 by — or just want to treat yourself? The Eurofurence Convention Store is your go-to spot for official convention merchandise and exclusive collectibles. Located right inside the Dealers’ Den, the store offers a handpicked selection of themed items that celebrate the spirit of Eurofurence and help you bring a bit of that magic home.

You’ll also find a selection of memorabilia from previous years — if there’s a design you missed, feel free to ask; we might still have a few hidden treasures in stock. Whether you’re after practical convention gear or a souvenir to commemorate your trip, the Convention Store has you covered. Stop by and see what’s in store!

To keep track of everything that happens in the Dealers’ Den, the official Eurofurence app allows you to search and sort the list of artists and dealers. That way, you always have a good overview and can plan in advance! It’s the easiest way to find your way around and get the latest info from the Dealers' Den.

slots.abstract:
In July a call went out to interested attendees: Would you like to learn how to play taiko drums? And then get to show off what you learned at Eurofurence? What would it be like to bring the astuteness of the foxes and the deep rumble and dance of cats and dogs together? Those who joined the video workshops and enlisted to the video courses finally meet in person. On our main stage, the craft of drumming and the tutoring of the Bastards come together to form the ensemble for the band’s finale!

This workshop is only open to those who enlisted in the video tutorials earlier this year. After training the voices and calls of cat, dog and fox, they come together for one glorious finale at Eurofurence. If you want to enjoy the labors of practicing and see both the band and the volunteering participants in the grand finale, you must not miss the concert!

slots.abstract:
Retirement may seem complicated, but the ideas behind it are easier to understand than you might think. Join a retirement actuary in a follow up to last year's panel with new
insights and discussion. We'll have a fun approachable look at how retirement systems work, and how they aren't much different than a furcon.
slots.description:
Expanding from last year, we'll revisit key concepts in retirement and compare them to
furcons and fursuits. By relating this complex and scary idea to concepts we're already
familiar with, we can better understand the mathematics behind the scenes. We'll explore foundational retirement planning, including state pensions and annuities, in a way that becomes accessible and fun to all.

Need a break from the festivities, or just want to hang out with fellow nerds? Then this panel might be for you!
I'm k3rnel-pan1c (or Panic for short), a software/systems engineer who loves talking about the topics I work with daily, so let's geek out together!
Novices and grand masters alike are welcome, let's have a great time!
slots.description:
This panel is held by a nerd for fellow nerds and anyone else interested in technology and IT.
I'm k3rnel-pan1c (or Panic for short), a software/systems engineer who loves talking about the topics I work with daily.
This panel will be a loosely structured event with three prepared topics and a basic slide deck to help illustrate what I am talking about.
I plan to talk about version control, release management and Kubernetes.
However, I welcome audience participation and am happy to improvise and nerd out with you about everything technology (except "AI")!
Whether you are a novice or an expert, I hope to provide you with an interesting panel and a good time with like-minded people!

slots.abstract:
You like listening to video game music? Let's hang out and talk! At this meetup we have
tables for different genres where you can discuss your favorite soundtracks, composers,
and share hidden gems. If you want, you can also participate in a short poll about your
listening habits.
slots.description:
Many gamers enjoy listening to video game music even when they?re not playing. Maybe
Stardew Valley is your go-to soundtrack while relaxing or studying. Or maybe DOOM helps
you power through a workout.

This meetup is a chance to find like-minded furs and talk about that shared passion. The
room will be organized into several tables, each representing a different style of VGM.
Everyone is free to choose a table and start chatting. Icebreaker prompts will be
available if you need a starting point, but the conversation is entirely up to the group.

Each table will also have a recommendation sheet where you can write down your favorite
tracks, games, and composers for others to discover. It?s a great chance to find new
soundtracks, spread your love for certain tracks, and celebrate the music of video games
together!

slots.abstract: Furrys and Animefans are two Fandoms with many smiliarities and connections! Let's explore them together and how Eurofurence and DoKomi, the largest European events of those two fandoms came together and learned from each other.
slots.description:
This panel is being hosted by CatboyFisky, one of two Co-Founders of DoKomi, active VTuber and Anime Community Veteran, but relatively fresh in the active Furry Community.

Let's explore together what the two fandoms have in common, where they vary and what they can learn from each other. The panel is meant to be lighthearted view and perspective from someone, who has been deeply involved in the fandom trenches and extremely passionate about community building.

You will also receive a bit of insider perspective on how DoKomi and Eurofurence have worked together behind the scenes lately.

Let's explore together what the two fandoms have in common, where they vary and what they can learn from each other. The panel is meant to be lighthearted view and perspective from someone, who has been deeply involved in the fandom trenches and extremely passionate about community building.

You will also receive a bit of insider perspective on how DoKomi and Eurofurence have worked together behind the scenes lately.
slots.title: DoKomi meets Eurofurence: Two Fandoms come together

#ef30 #ef30dance #fursuitdance
slots.description:
We celebrate 30 issues of Eurofurence!

It's a Festival. It's special. And some people thought: We need a dance that will always remind us of that great anniversary.

So we came up with this easy to learn, short choreography that works with almost every song and also anywhere inside and outside CCH, from the biggest dancefloor to the smallest queue... as long as there's music (hint: Eurodance works best... wait for the chorus to start, pull in your friends, and then repeat until you suffer ;)

Just choose your favourite music, we recommend 110 bpm or less for beginners, up to 145 for the skilled ones ;)

  • Link 1
    This short example video shows the dance in full.
    Share it a lot so we gather many dancers! Tag it #ef30 #ef30dance #fursuitdance (but fursuit not required :)

We'd also love to see many more Furrys to perform the dance and upload it to the their channel of choice.

  • Link 2
    A full tutorial with instructions for each move (and even some music theory ;) can also be found in the example video.
    Take your time to find out how the dance works. You may spot some references to "3 decades of EF". Share your findings if you like ;)

  • Telegram group
    to connect with other dancers and to stay informed about any bigger appearances or flashmobs during the Con.

Thanks a lot to Fezzle & GermanSkrat for inspiration and to JD Puppy for the great tutorials!

(Note: there is also the 'Large Group Dance' by JD_Puppy – which has a full length choreography for ambitious dancers. Don't miss that one aswell :)

Whilst you can look forward to the energetic madness of their current artistic repertory, bringing their distinct interpretation of European contemporary taiko drumming to the stage.
However, for this year’s Eurofurence, we are truly in for a treat: Earlier this year, the Bastards put out a call to attendees to join in a series of workshops: After training the voices and calls of cat, dog and fox, attendees and the Taiko Bastards come together for one glorious finale at Eurofurence, debuting their newest work together with furries from the fandom for the celebration at Eurofurence

slots.abstract:
First Edition of charity funding poker for
Eurofurence! Seek out the charity booth and get the chance at
claiming the title of EF Poker Tournament Winner 2026! Anyone is welcome
to come and learn before or during the event :)
slots.description:
Join us for a chance to claim the title of "Eurofurence Charity Poker Champion 2026". Participation is open to anyone making a donating of at least €15 to charity in the Charity Booth. Please state your intent to join the tournament at the booth after donating. Afterwards, please also remember to ensure participation by following the instructions that come with the available vouchers in a timely manner.

There are 20 slots in the tournament - Two preliminary tables will be played for this tournament. Once we're down to 10 players total, the tables will be merged into one to then figure out the first, second and third places!

The atmosphere of this tournament is meant to be fun, laid back and enjoyable to all - experienced, amateurs and new players. We expect new players to know the basic rules of texas' holdem as a minimum, and for experienced players to behave sportsmanlike.

Please note that there will be no rebuys or add-ons! You have one stack for one dream ;)
More information, rules and regulations can be found here: https://www.eurofurence.org/EF30/poker-tournament/

Chaos is part of life, so why not enjoy it? Yes, It’s Warm! are an alt-rock band, and we’re bringing one wild, theatrical, high-energy night to EF, where the genres bend and anything can happen. Seven chaotic animals, one stage, one night only. Come celebrate chaos with us!
slots.description:
The best things that ever happened to you were never planned. The friendships that started by accident. The nights that went completely off the rails and became the ones you still talk about. The wrong turns that somehow led you exactly where you needed to be.

It goes all the way back. The universe itself began with an explosion, a single wild moment that flung every star and planet and living thing into being out of pure chaos. You are here, reading this, because the universe refused to play it safe. And it turned out beautiful.

This won’t be a concert that stands politely and plays its songs. Yes, It’s Warm! are an alt-rock band, and this is one night built like a storm: Lights, noise, surprises, and moments you will not see coming. A show that swings from a whisper to a roar and drags you along for every second of it.

Seven chaotic animals. One stage. One night that will never happen again.

Come celebrate chaos with us.

slots.abstract: Easygoing meetup for furries on the aromantic or asexual spectrum (or both) to learn, meet, share experiences and get support. Are you still questioning, or the partner of an aro/ace fur? Come join us!
slots.description:
Are you on the asexual and/or aromantic spectrum, or perhaps questioning whether you are? Then come join us for this cozy social event! For the fourth time, we will get to ponder the very important question: Which is better, cake or garlic bread?
Share experiences, ask questions and just have a chill time together - everyone is welcome, whether you are demi, grey, aro&ace or only one of the two, your experience is valid. (Neither garlic bread nor cake provided :c)

slots.abstract: Join the furry band Wildpact for an energetic live concert! They will be playing covers of famous rock and metal songs from bands around the world. Whether you like classic rock from the 80’s, or modern metal from the current era, they got you covered at this wild concert!
slots.description:
With band members hailing from Norway, Ukraine, Italy, Hungary and Finland – some of them even performing in fursuit!, – Wildpact brings together the furries who are also rock & metal fans, and celebrate the power of heavy music in one explosive show. Played by real instruments, with all the passion that live music brings!
Wildpact plays a wide variety of genres and subgenres: classic rock, symphonic metal, industrial metal, folk metal, nu metal, and some modern metal versions of well-known classics, just to name a few. Also, some surprise guests may join the fun!
Get ready for roaring guitars, thundering drums, crazy solos and unstoppable energy! Don’t miss it – It is more than just a concert. It’s a celebration of live music and pure metal fire! \m/

slots.abstract:
ONLY GOOD VIBES AND GREAT CREATURES ALLOWED!

Club Animalz is about providing a fun, carefree, loving environment for pup, and furries to party. The problems of the outside world should be left at the door and inside the party concentrates on what unites us!
slots.description:
MUSIC TO WAG TO
Animalz brings DJs from across furry, pup, and fetish communities to play great music to dance too! We feature a variety of genres ranging from Pop mashups, House, EDM, to darker techno. Its a fun pace to make new friends and let out the wild animal inside you.

BE YOURSELF
Never apologise for being yourself... wear whatever makes you comfortable and be the animal you want to be! Fursuits, Puppy, Gear head, farmer, rubber, drone, inmate, prison guard, gimp, or just a T-Shirt & Jeans! Be unashamedly you! Sex, body type, or orientation has no bias at Club Animalz.

Our dress and conduct code is simple - no genitals or butts are too be on display. No sex. Look after each other! Simple.... ❤️

slots.abstract: Interested in inflatable toys and everything that has to do with them? Then this is the event for you!
slots.description:
Interested in inflatable toys and everything that has to do with them? Then this is the event for you! The inflatable community gathering is Eurofurence's annual meeting to bring the inflatable furry community together, show toys, share experiences and nerd around about vinyl, air pressure and lots of squeakiness! We got a room, we got some pumps and we have way too much empty space! So bring some toys, fill that room and make new friends!

Please note that this is a family-friendly gathering, open to everyone and rated PG-13. Some inflatables are unique, expensive and impossible to replace. So please remember to treat people and their toys with respect and ask the owners for permission before touching or even riding these toys. All toys are welcome as long as they are originals – no knock-offs!

Please note that Balloons are not allowed!

slots.abstract:
Bring your crayons or grab your favorite plushie and immerse yourself in your personal
Littlespace.
slots.description:
Raise your Little Paws, be proud!

Little Furs and ABDL Meet and Greet at Eurofurence 2026

Let your inner Little shine at this meet and greet in a relaxed and friendly atmosphere!

Bring your crayons or grab your favorite plushie and immerse yourself in your personal
Littlespace. For many years, our community has included members who find particular joy in
embodying and expressing a younger character, who love being Littles. The ageplayer
community is just as colorful and diverse as the fandom itself, ranging from Adult Baby
(AB) to Diaper Lover (DL). For many years, they lived under the radar, fearing
discrimination and a misplaced fear of rejection. Meetings were often private, and only
then did they have the chance to be true to themselves. But hiding is not the path to
tolerance, acceptance, and pride! That's exactly what I want to change, because we are all
wonderful and have every right to be proud of ourselves!

Looking back over the last 14 years, the number of Littlefurs and Littlepuppies is
constantly growing, and the scene is experiencing increasing popularity. This meet and
greet is intended to offer a safe space within our community where you can develop and
express yourselves, where you can be yourselves, among like-minded people from all over
the world!

As for me, I'm part of the organizing team for a large ABDL event in Berlin, the very
popular "Summer Camp" at Quälgeist Berlin e.V. I've been involved for over 14 years now
and can therefore give you an insight into the development of the community from its
beginnings to the present day. But how have you experienced it yourselves? I look forward
to many conversations with you!

Sincerely, Sazi Rainbowwolf. The panel is sponsored by ABU, Crinklz, Cloudryz,
Snuggleplanet, Frechdax Hamburg Fietes Fete and Quälgeist Berlin.
