slots.abstract: The festival taking its toll on you? Come in and relax for a while, take off your costume, and you’ll be ready to party once more within no time! There’s limited space, so be mindful of the needs of others. As long as you can do that, we’ll do our best try to make sure the party never ends!
slots.description:
The festival taking its toll on you? Come in and relax for a while, take off your costume, and you’ll be ready to party once more within no time! There’s limited space, so be mindful of the needs of others. As long as you can do that, we’ll do our best try to make sure the party never ends!
Services:
For those of you who are new around here; welcome! Here’s a short summary of what you can expect from us:

BLOWERS and DRYERS
We have two kinds of fans; some to cool you down, and others to dry your party outfits. You’re free to use them, but due to the limited space, we kindly request you only use them as long as you need. And remember, we don’t take kindly to people mixing them up, spraying the sweat from their costumes into the faces of those trying to cool down; any parts of costumes or clothing found on fans intended to cool people will be removed.

DRINKS and SNACKS
To try and keep the party going, and not in the direction of the first aid station, we’ve got some free hydrating drinks and snacks for those who need it. Nobody likes messy festival grounds, so please reuse the cups if you can (or even bring your own - we don’t mind)! Oh, and please try to keep your costumes and the food separated?

REPAIR WORKSHOP
We try to support even the fanciest, most technical of costumes. We’ve got a repair corner, so if anything is broken, hopefully you’ll be able to patch it up there in no time. Don’t be afraid to ask for help, people are often more than happy to help others!

HELPERS
As always, we’ve got a team of people there to help you. We know some of you have trouble getting in and out of your costumes. Who designs these things anyway, why is the zipper always in such hard to reach places?! Anyway… for that, and anything else you might think of: feel free to ask one of the crew, and they’ll try their best to help you!
Rules:
To make sure everyone stays safe, here is a short list of rules to follow. Please don't argue with our staff if they ask you to follow these simple rules.

NO GLASS IS ALLOWED IN THE FURSUIT LOUNGE.
Drinking glasses and bottles are a lot more dangerous than you might think in a room full of overheating, badly coordinated, half dressed people. To keep everyone and their costumes safe from shards, we don’t allow glass in here. Any glass found will be confiscated, empty or not.

NO PAINT OR OUTSIDE FOOD.
As with glass, “But I’ll be careful!” is not a valid excuse when you’re surrounded with tired, vision-impaired, and possibly inebriated people.

DON’T BLOCK THE FANS.
The fans are there for cooling down, not for spraying sweat all over. If you want to blow your sweat into the faces of others, do that elsewhere. Not to mention, we’d rather not have our fans suck your gear in and catch on fire.

Additionally, we have a lot more visitors than we have space for. Please keep your costumes on the drying constructions for 2 hours at most - any longer than that, and we might have to lend you a hand in making room for others.

NO PHOTO OR VIDEO RECORDING.
People come here to relax, not to be wary of anyone photographing or recording them half-clothed. If you want to take pictures, go elsewhere. No exceptions.

NO SHAPE-RETAINING FURSUIT CASES.
We have limited space to work with, and we are always full. To help as many people as we can, we have to make sure that any bags take as little room as possible while empty. To ensure this, we don’t allow bags and cases that take up as much space full as they do while empty. Bags and cases found breaking these rules might be moved to lost and found.
Location:
Same location as last year, for those who remember it. For those who do not: Hall H, sections 3/4! … and if you can’t find it, just follow the signs, or the constant stream of exhausted party-goers tugging at their costumes.

To try and keep the party going, and not in the direction of the first aid station, we’ve got some free hydrating drinks and snacks for those who need it. Nobody likes messy festival grounds, so please reuse the cups if you can (or even bring your own - we don’t mind)! Oh, and please try to keep your costumes and the food separated?

**REPAIR WORKSHOP**
We try to support even the fanciest, most technical of costumes. We’ve got a repair corner, so if anything is broken, hopefully you’ll be able to patch it up there in no time. Don’t be afraid to ask for help, people are often more than happy to help others!

**HELPERS**
As always, we’ve got a team of people there to help you. We know some of you have trouble getting in and out of your costumes. Who designs these things anyway, why is the zipper always in such hard to reach places?! Anyway… for that, and anything else you might think of: feel free to ask one of the crew, and they’ll try their best to help you!
Rules:
To make sure everyone stays safe, here is a short list of rules to follow. Please don't argue with our staff if they ask you to follow these simple rules.

**NO GLASS IS ALLOWED IN THE FURSUIT LOUNGE.**
Drinking glasses and bottles are a lot more dangerous than you might think in a room full of overheating, badly coordinated, half dressed people. To keep everyone and their costumes safe from shards, we don’t allow glass in here. Any glass found will be confiscated, empty or not.

**NO PAINT OR OUTSIDE FOOD.**
As with glass, “But I’ll be careful!” is not a valid excuse when you’re surrounded with tired, vision-impaired, and possibly inebriated people.

**DON’T BLOCK THE FANS.**
The fans are there for cooling down, not for spraying sweat all over. If you want to blow your sweat into the faces of others, do that elsewhere. Not to mention, we’d rather not have our fans suck your gear in and catch on fire.

Additionally, we have a lot more visitors than we have space for. Please keep your costumes on the drying constructions for 2 hours at most - any longer than that, and we might have to lend you a hand in making room for others.

**NO PHOTO OR VIDEO RECORDING.**
People come here to relax, not to be wary of anyone photographing or recording them half-clothed. If you want to take pictures, go elsewhere. No exceptions.

**NO SHAPE-RETAINING FURSUIT CASES.**
We have limited space to work with, and we are always full. To help as many people as we can, we have to make sure that any bags take as little room as possible while empty. To ensure this, we don’t allow bags and cases that take up as much space full as they do while empty. Bags and cases found breaking these rules might be moved to lost and found.
Location:
Same location as last year, for those who remember it. For those who do not: Hall H, sections 3/4! … and if you can’t find it, just follow the signs, or the constant stream of exhausted party-goers tugging at their costumes.

slots.abstract: Meet talented creators offering sketches, badges, prints and more in a casual, ever-changing space. Artists can join on a first-come, first-served basis, making each visit a unique experience. Stop by, browse the art and enjoy a chat with the artists.
slots.description:
The Artist Alley is a vibrant space, located in Foyer Z, where artists can showcase and sell prints, badges, sketches, commissions, books, comics, T-shirts and even more. Whether you're a fan looking to discover unique art or a creative mind wanting to share your creations, the Artist Alley is the perfect place to connect and engage.

With the Eurofurence smartphone app, you can now stay up-to-date with a flexible seating plan, letting you know who is selling at the Artist Alley right now. Take some time to explore the offerings, have a proper look at the goods, and enjoy a pleasant chat with the artists.

Haven’t applied for the Dealers’ Den but love to draw or craft?
Then the Artist Alley might be just the place for you! There is no application necessary. Just grab an empty table on a "first come, first served" basis and follow the sign-up instructions located at each seat. Feel free to offer your services with sketches, badges, prints, and a smile. If you decide to take a break or have enough work to keep you busy, give another artist the opportunity by handing over an empty table.

slots.abstract: Meet fellow artists in a calm, social space to draw, chat, and share ideas. Whether you're working on commissions or just sketching for fun, this is the perfect spot to connect, relax, and enjoy the creative spirit of the fandom together.
slots.description:
Let's be creative together!
Do you enjoy spending your evenings with other fellow and like-minded artists, drawing and chatting about techniques, supplies, and other creative topics? Need a moment to breathe after a strenuous day in the Artist Alley or the Dealers’ Den but still crave creative surroundings? Want a space to have a heartfelt, creative conversation with the artist you haven’t seen at their table during the convention day? Then this social event, taking place every day, is the right place for you!

Sit down with other creatives, share ideas, learn new techniques, chat and have a good time while working on your convention commissions or just being interested in drawing and the art in Furry Fandom. Collaborate on your Dealers’ Den homework with other crafty souls! Our Artists’ Lounge is a hub to escape the buzz of stage events and the convention schedule.

Please note, the Lounge is not curated nor permanently staffed: Be fair and pass on your seat if you won’t be returning for a while. Don’t leave your belongings unattended. If you need immediate help, please contact Security or Con Ops. For any organizational input, visit the Art Show or Dealers’ Den Help Desks during their opening times.

slots.abstract:
A relaxed SCUBA meetup with a short intro, a few underwater clips, and lots of open Q&A.
Learn how to get started, what gear actually matters, and what diving really feels like.
Come hang out, ask anything, and get hands-on with real equipment.
slots.description:
A chill, festival-style SCUBA meetup with a short opening panel and a long, open
conversation afterwards.
We start with a quick and easy introduction into scuba diving. What it is, how you get
started, what your first steps look like, and what actually matters in the beginning. No
overload, no gatekeeping, just a clear and honest overview.
After that, we watch 1?2 short underwater clips to give a real feeling for the environment
and experience.
Then the main part begins: an open Q&A and meetup space.
Ask anything you want. Training, safety, gear, cold water, fears, funny stories, mistakes,
or just curiosity. This is meant to feel like the photography meetups. Casual,
interactive, and driven by the people in the room.
There will also be some real scuba gear on display that you can take a closer look at and
ask questions about it.
Whether you are just curious, thinking about starting, or already diving, you are welcome
to join, listen, share, and hang out.

slots.abstract:
Thinking about starting furry content creation but don't want to quit your day job? An
existing creator that lost your spark? Feeling burned out or stuck? This talk is for you.
I'll break down the illusion of "going full-time", how to find your real "why", starting
small with strong fundamentals, simple tech setups (all free/cheap options), and most
importantly ? how to stay authentic and avoid burnout as a part-time creator. No fursuit
required. Let's grow something real, one small step at a time.
slots.description:
Ever dreamed of making furry content but felt overwhelmed by the pressure to go viral or
quit your job? Started strong and then burned out? Or just want to get back into it
without losing your mind?In this honest and practical talk I'll share how I started my own
journey (out of pure pettiness at first) and turned it into something sustainable. We'll
cover:
- Why treating content creation like a full-time job right away is a trap
- Figuring out what YOU actually want and what you can realistically offer
- Starting small and building strong fundamentals (because a bad foundation will crash
later)
- Quick look at free/cheap tools: OBS, DaVinci Resolve, basic VTubing software, and why
sound matters more than fancy gear
- The real power of authenticity ? being you instead of chasing trends
- How to do this part-time without burning out: control your energy, pivot when tired,
fill your own cup first, and most importantly ? have fun

We'll be real about the slim chances of going full-time (high competition, flooded market,
brutal algorithms), but I'll show you how you can still have a rich, joyful creative life
in the fandom on your own terms.
You don't need a fursuit, thousands of followers, or to post every day. You just need to
plant the seed and water it gently. If you're ready to start (or restart) without the
pressure, this one's for you.

I'll stick around after for questions and I'll share my simple setup guide too.

slots.abstract:
Open space presentation / workshop for everyone interested to get to know about
ponyplay.
slots.description:
During this panel you will get a theoretical introduction into ponyplay with the
purpose to give everyone attending an idea about the diversity of playstyles and
possibilities. We will talk about motivations, mindset, gear and everything else
that is related to becoming a horse and where it may overlap with the furry
community. Look forward to learn something about a pretty niche kinky playstyle
with a wide variety of things to do and how you could combine it with your furry
persona. Some gear will be present too for checking out. Everyone who is attending
this presentation will have the chance to sign up for the follow up "Show and
Tell" workshop "Ponyplay - Let's try" where you will actually have the chance to
try out some gear and maybe make your first steps as a horse. Consider the whole
atmosphere to be very open, friendly and casual. So you don?t need to dress up at
all (unless you want). If you decide to dress up, please keep in mind about the EF
Rules of conduct.

Resonite is a social VR sandbox developed & played by furries. Whether you're a
seasoned player or simply curious, feel free to join our meetup to hang out, ask

slots.description:
Resonite is a social VR sandbox platform developed by furries, for furries! It's a virtual place where people with all skill levels from across the world come together to hang out and collaborate in real-time to build beautiful worlds, immersive experiences, interactive avatars and silly gadgets right in the game.

Feel free to join our meetup, regardless of if you're an active Resonite player or simply curious about it. We want to hang out, discuss ideas, share stories and resonate together. We're joined by Resonite's lead developer Frooxius as well as Jae AKA J4 from the Resonite development team, so if you have any questions this is a great opportunity to ask those!

slots.abstract: Explore artwork, fursuits, handmade goods, and convention-exclusive treasures from talented creators. Don’t miss the Convention Store for official Eurofurence merch and rare collectibles — the perfect way to take a piece of the convention home with you.
slots.description:
Step into the glow of the Dealers' Den in Hall H, Sections 6 to 8, where artists and creators from across the fandom come together to share their work. You'll find a wide range of treasures to explore — from prints, badges, sketches, commissions, books, comics, and T-shirts to handmade accessories, fursuits, and sweet treats.

Whether you're looking for something specific or just browsing, take your time and enjoy the variety. Many dealers created themed goods and Eurofurence exclusives that you won't find anywhere else. It's a great opportunity to take a piece of the convention home with you.

Looking for something to remember EF 30 by — or just want to treat yourself? The Eurofurence Convention Store is your go-to spot for official convention merchandise and exclusive collectibles. Located right inside the Dealers’ Den, the store offers a handpicked selection of themed items that celebrate the spirit of Eurofurence and help you bring a bit of that magic home.

You’ll also find a selection of memorabilia from previous years — if there’s a design you missed, feel free to ask; we might still have a few hidden treasures in stock. Whether you’re after practical convention gear or a souvenir to commemorate your trip, the Convention Store has you covered. Stop by and see what’s in store!

To keep track of everything that happens in the Dealers’ Den, the official Eurofurence app allows you to search and sort the list of artists and dealers. That way, you always have a good overview and can plan in advance! It’s the easiest way to find your way around and get the latest info from the Dealers' Den.

slots.abstract:
Aidshilfe Hamburg is returning to Eurofurence! Drop by
their booth for friendly tips and information on safer sex, STIs, and how to look after
and protect both yourself and your partners.
In an additional effort to support community health, they will be offering
HIV-quick-tests.
slots.description:
The topic is omnipresent in our society, and even in the ever-growing furry
fandom. It happens that people are affected, whether directly or indirectly. We're talking
about sexually transmittable infections (STI for short) and it's not only about HIV and
AIDS, it's about much more. Because it's important to be well informed about this topic,
we invited the Aidshilfe Hamburg e.V. to do their information work at Eurofurence. For
that they will be there with an information booth. So, don't hesitate to speak with them.
This year they also offer HIV-Quicktests, you will get more Information at their booth.

We let the sparks fly within this show!
You can be there and get a piece of Eurofurence History, when we will cut art pieces out of the car painted by Animal Art Crimes, their friends and attendees!

As Auctioneer the incredible Uncle Kage will join our panel to moderate and sell these one of a kind art pieces.

Eurofurence 30
🗓Painting the Car: August 19-21, 2026

slots.description:
ART CRIMES. ANGLE GRINDERS. CHARITY.
Our Guests of Honor Animal Art Crimes needed a ride from the USA to Eurofurence 30 in Hamburg.
So ~~naturally~~ allegedly, they stole a car and after one extremely questionable road trip across the Atlantic, the vehicle has finally made it to EF.

Is it roadworthy? - Absolutely not.
Is it still in one piece? - For now!
Did Kenket, WopBol, NoFair and DominoTwist arrive in time for the festival? - Thats all that matters.

From Wednesday to Friday, Animal Art Crimes, their friends and you(!) will transform the battered getaway car into one enormous collaborative artwork.

Then, on Saturday at 13:00 (after the EF Group Photo), the evidence will be deconstructed and it's pieces given to the highest bidder.

Join us on the CCH Roof Terrace as two fearless cutters take angle grinders to the car and turn it into unique pieces of Eurofurence history: live, loud and with plenty of sparks.

And because every good crime story needs a mastermind, the incredible Uncle Kage will auction the resulting artworks for charity.

Help paint the getaway car from Wednesday to Friday,
watch it get spectacularly dismantled and support a good cause by bidding on a one-of-a-kind piece of EF30 history on Saturday (Project: "Backstreet Car") .

Come for the art. Stay for the sparks.
Leave with part of the evidence and don't tell the EF security.

Animal Art Crimes: The Final Getaway
Only at Eurofurence 30 Fantastic Furry Festival

Eurofurence 30
🗓Painting the Car: August 19-21, 2026

🗓Auction: August 22, 2026 13:00

📍 CCH Roof Terrace, Hamburg

The Art pieces will be stored by AS-Department and can be retrieved at the ArtShow Sales and Pick Up ( Saturday 13:00-19:00)

slots.abstract:
Want to know why some animations feel smooth, snappy, and full of life? Learn the basics
of animation, the tricks animators use to make movement look good, and the logic behind
motion. I'll break it down and together animate a furry bouncy ball!
slots.description:
My name is Simon, I'm a professional Motion Designer and Animator! In this panel, I'll
show a beginner-friendly look at the fundamentals of animation. I'll talk about things
like timing, spacing, squash and stretch, anticipation, and other tricks animators use to
make movement feel natural, expressive, and fun. Without breaking a sweat!

We'll take a practice approach, move around and draw together to understand "why" behind
the movement. Whether you're interested in animating your fursona, making simple loops for
your social media or you're just curious about how animation works, this panel is a great
place to start. No experience required!

slots.abstract: Say Hi to furs in VRChat from all over the world via our two-way interactive streaming installation!
slots.description:
Online attendees can explore a VRChat world by the VirtualFurence Team that seamlessly connects VRChat with the convention space. Created in partnership with the Eurofurence VR department, which presents and operates the convention-side installation, the experience forges a bridge between both, the virtual and physical world.

The portal also has additional options for interacting with participants on the virtual side:

  • Give other furs a phone call through Virtual Reality using our interactive VRChat Phone installation.
    You can both accept and make calls to designated phones on-site and in VR. Just pick up when the phone is ringing or call someone yourself.

  • From time to time, operators will hand out motion-tracked controllers or other devices that can be used to influence the virtual world from the convention space.

For more information, visit https://ef-vr.awoo.digital/

slots.abstract:
First Edition of charity funding poker for
Eurofurence! Seek out the charity booth and get the chance at
claiming the title of EF Poker Tournament Winner 2026! Anyone is welcome
to come and learn before or during the event :)
slots.description:
Join us for a chance to claim the title of "Eurofurence Charity Poker Champion 2026". Participation is open to anyone making a donating of at least €15 to charity in the Charity Booth. Please state your intent to join the tournament at the booth after donating. Afterwards, please also remember to ensure participation by following the instructions that come with the available vouchers in a timely manner.

There are 20 slots in the tournament - Two preliminary tables will be played for this tournament. slots.abstract: Join us in this brief journey of the history of anthro literature, from the oldest classics to the newest works. Learn about various comics, mangas and visual novels, and get ready to find your next great read.
slots.description:
Writing has always been a powerful medium that inspired a lot of people, including furries, and there are a lot of documented stories with anthro characters, not just books or comics but also mangas and graphic novels that have significantly contributed to the growth of the fandom over the years.

This panel aims to showcase and discuss some of the most influential works, starting from the oldest comic classics and following through the newest mangas. Tracing this journey will create a very interesting debate about how storytelling has evolved along the fandom, while also introducing attendees to new titles that might spark their interest for reading.

slots.abstract: Learn to turn your plushie ideas into patterns using tools like Plushify and other simple methods in this panel!
slots.description:
Many of us have one or many plushies - be it for display purposes, as companions to keep
our deepest secrets, or as a guardian at night. And while there are a ton of mass-produced
plushies available, having a plushie of your own fursona is something very special.

This panel will teach you how to create your own plushie patterns. We will go over
traditional methods of creating patterns before diving into digital tools like 3D modeling
and Plushify to make the plushie design process as easy as possible.

A body has been discovered hanging limp from the clocktower. A demon has been unleashed,
killing by night and taking on human form by day. Can good find the demon in time?
slots.description:
A social game played in person, seated in a circle, each player receives either a good or evil token with their unique character on it. Good players share information to solve
the mystery whilst evil players lie about who they are and what they know. The good team
wins if they can piece together their knowledge, trust each other, and execute the demon.
The evil team wins if the demon can sow distrust, evade detection, and wipe out the
village.

Depending on interest and group sizes we are playing rounds in German and English.

But not to worry, it's far from the last point on the schedule. Sure, all good
things must come to an end, but that should not stop you from making the final
night at Eurofurence as epic as it can be!

Let's take this moment to talk about all the awesome things that happened at EF30.
Let's celebrate all your fellow furs who run this convention voluntarily. Enjoy
some fun statistics from the convention, find out the preliminary charity numbers,
and get a first glimpse of what's in store for EF31!
slots.raw_abstract:
As the last guitar solo echoes over the festival grounds, Eurofurence nears its
final encore. Before we part ways, let's gather once more to celebrate this con,
our community, and everyone who helped make the 30th (!) edition of Eurofurence
legendary. One more song! One more song! One more song!

slots.abstract: Ever wonder why there are so many board games with anthro characters? Do you know them all? Join us for a quick introduction to some great furry themed board games out there and let's play a few of them. I am sure you will be surprised and will be adding new games to your shopping list. Come for the games, stay for the company. Please, bring your own furry board games too if you have any!
slots.description: Anthropomorphic characters have been a staple of tabletop gaming for a while, but how many furry-themed board games are available today? This panel offers an introduction to a curated selection of furry and anthro-themed board games, exploring what makes each title unique. Attendees will have the opportunity to try out a few of them firsthand and of course find out if they are worth adding to their collection or not. If you already have a few, bring them over!

slots.description: In this live edition of the FlauschPlausch podcast, we bring our living-room atmosphere to the Eurofurence stage. slots.abstract: A concert of Yes, It’s Warm! / Fons & Friends but acoustically instead of electric high power distorted guitars, to sit down, sing along to, and take a coffee or wine to it. Soft warm light and just chill!
slots.description:
Come catch Yes, It’s Warm! the way you’ve probably never heard us, unplugged.

For one evening, “Fons & Friends” trade the distorted guitars and full-volume chaos for something softer: acoustic, stripped-back versions of our songs, played in warm low light with a drink in your hand. Grab a coffee or a glass of wine, find a seat, and settle in.

This is the quiet counterpart to our main show, same songs, same heart, but slowed down and turned up close. Sing along if you know the words, hum along if you don’t, or just sit back and let it wash over you.

And because it’s that kind of night, there’ll be room to actually talk to us, ask questions, chat between songs, request a tune, or just hang out. Less “band on a stage,” more “friends in a room.”

No mosh pit, no wall of sound, just us, you, and a warm room. (It’s in the name, after all.)

slots.abstract:
In Habitat 6, where the corporate feeds won't go, "The Truest Crime" streams murder
straight from the killer's own eyes - and show master Victor "VeeVee" Vex gives the masses
exactly that truth. The latest case looks simple: gulch dealer Tilman Mercer, the city's
most wanted face, hunted by police chief Ryce while security specialist Lux Veyra starts
patching holes that Sentinel Vision pretends don't exist - but in this city, the most
dangerous weapon is never just a gun.
slots.description:
You've seen the footage. Everyone has. While the city of Habitat 6 is rotting from the inside, "The Truest Crime"* takes you somewhere the corporate feeds won't - behind the eyes of those who pulled the trigger. Literally. Show host Victor "VeeVee" Vex has built an empire giving the masses exactly what they're too polite to admit they want: the raw, uncut truth of what it looks like when someone decides another person's right to live no longer applies. The truth deserves an audience, as does the latest case of Tilman Mercer - used augments dealer, gulch raccoon, and now the most wanted face in the city. Lux Veyra - security specialist, and now patching the holes that Sentinel Vision pretends don't exist. Corporate police chief Ryce is already sharpening his teeth. He knows better than anyone that in this city the most dangerous weapon is not a gun. The case looks simple ... it never is.

  • Not suitable for viewers who still believe in coincidence.

slots.abstract:
This panel will be about linear perspective. This
perspective creates an illusion of 3d-depth and distance by assuming, that groups of
parallel lines go straight into special points (called vanishing points), making the drawn
objects smaller they appear closer to the vanishing points, thus making objects look like
they were seen by observer's eyes.
This old technique is used for centuries, especially since renaissance, but many, many
artists, not even furry artist only have huge problems creating proper three-dimensional
illusions, simply by not-understanding, or even not-knowing basics of linear perspective,
despite those basics are very simple and could be explained by middle-school mathematics.
slots.description:
In this panel, there will be explained basics of perspective, kinds of
linear perspective, examples, common mistakes and limits. There will be also presented
tricks to create regular, pararell divisions or replications of objects in perspective,
use in scenery, characters and relationship between characters and scenery in perspective
(may include basics of composition). There will be presented a way to make more rays
(helping, mostly imaginery pararell lines going to vanishing points), when there is no way
to draw vanishing points. All backed and explained by science and using only pencils and
pieces of parer.

slots.abstract:
For novices, beginners, and curious practitioners.
Join us for a welcoming introduction to the art of shibari, a practice rooted as much in trust and connection as it is in technique. We'll cover everything you need to get started
slots.description:
For novices, beginners, and curious practitioners.
Join us for a welcoming introduction to the art of shibari, a practice rooted as much in trust and connection as it is in technique. We'll cover everything you need to get started: Choosing the right ropes, using them safely and effectively, and caring for your partner. Because safe bondage involves more than just tying knots, we'll also walk through some essential technical foundations: Body awareness, safety protocols, and how physics plays a role in keeping things comfortable. We'll finish up with some patterns and knots you can take home and experiment with yourself.

Time permitting, we'll open the floor for Q&A.

We can offer some space to show your own skills. Please bring your own materials for that, as we can only provide some ropes in limited amounts.
Strictly no nudity. Fursuits encouraged. Be excellent to each other.

slots.abstract:
Violet & Freja return to Eurofurence to showcase
highlights of what furries and the wider demoscene has had to offer over the past year.
slots.description:
It's been a busy year for Violet & Freja, who has been spending a lot of
time travelling across Europe whilst attending many creative computer events known as
demoparties. After working on multiple of their own productions and taking notes on their
favourites released over the past year they are ready to return to Eurofurence and host an
extended show & tell about what the demoscene has had to offer.

Violet & Freja are two demofurs (demoscene furries) who previously hosted a panel at NFC
2025 and EF 29 about how furries have been getting involved in the demoscene, and this
year at EF they will continue to share more new productions by furries and also the wider
demoscene. They will also be hosting a Q&A between each of the demos, so everyone has a
chance to ask about the scene, the demos and maybe also learn something new.

On Sunday, August 23, 2026 at 13:30, we'll be boarding TWO barges at Überseebrücke for a nice 3 hour trip to say goodbye to Hamburg – until next year!

Our boats offer two different experiences to choose from while happening at the same time:

Boarding, departure and arrival are identical for both boats.

These smaller boats each offer half the capacity of our party boat and will primarily happen seated. Take a partial or stay suited during the entire cruise (emergency unsuiting possible in restrooms).

speakers.biography:
Hailing from Vienna’s vibrant electronic music scene, Operator Burstup stands as a multi-talented artist, musician and DJ whose captivating performances and innovative sounds have left an indelible mark on club culture. With a career spanning over three decades, he has graced the stages of renowned festivals and conventions, founded his own record label, and released an impressive catalog of albums with his band Schönheitsfehler and as a solo-artist.

Burstup performed at Vienna Comic Con for a remarkable ten years, and at furry conventions such as Brasil Fur Fest, Megaplex, Eurofurence, Confuzzled and Nordic Fuzz Con. He developed a unique style that fused elements of Hip-Hop, Trip-Hop, Jungle, Drum'n'Bass, Jungletek, Breaks, and House. His ability to seamlessly blend these genres into a cohesive and captivating soundscape set him apart from his contemporaries. 

Operator Burstup's dedication to pushing the boundaries of electronic music is evident in his constant exploration of new sounds and technologies. He regularly performs at VR events such as Furality and Placeholder Club,  infusing his music with fresh ideas and innovative techniques. 

In addition to his musical endeavors, Operator Burstup is also known for his work as a journalist, DJ and host at Radio FM4, a popular radio station of national broadcasting corporation ORF. He loves hosting panels and running workshops. Find out more about Operator Burstup at http://burstup.net
speakers.name: Burstup
